'''Darth Marr's flagship''',<ref name="Nadia">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=message|I will find you|Nadia Grell}}</ref> also known as '''Darth Marr's frigate''',<ref name="Raina">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=message|I'm not ready for this|Raina Temple}}</ref> was a [[Terminus-class destroyer|''Terminus''-class destroyer]] that was used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Dark Council]] member [[Darth Marr]] during the [[Galactic War]] while campaigning at [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] and then later within [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] before it was destroyed during an [[Destruction of Darth Marr's flagship|engagement]] with the [[Eternal Fleet]].<ref name="Chapter 1" />
